title: mentha aquatica var. arguta
intro: Mentha aquatica var. arguta, commonly known as water mint or American peppermint, is a variety of water mint, a perennial herb native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing digestive issues, alleviating headaches, and soothing respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mentha aquatica var. arguta are attributed to its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
